title: Prior-Remedy Multiplier: Hosting Charge Lines and Late-Provisioning Goodwill
content:
# Prior-remedy multiplier

**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts. Reads the plan's own charge lines on the Web Hosting Plans billing history.

The prior-remedy multiplier of the late-provisioning goodwill follows the plan's own charge lines: where the plan carries a refund line, the multiplier is 0.5; where it carries no refund line but carries an uptime service credit line, the multiplier is 0.8; where it carries neither, the multiplier is one. It multiplies the late-provisioning goodwill figure.

## Truth table

| Refund line on the plan | Uptime service credit line on the plan | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 0.5 |
| yes | no | 0.5 |
| no | yes | 0.8 |
| no | no | 1 |

## Training note

Where the plan carries both kinds of line, the refund line decides and the multiplier is 0.5. Only the plan's own charge lines are read; a refund on another holding does not count. Example with hypothetical figures: a figure of $11.30 on a plan carrying one uptime service credit line becomes $9.04.
